Committee: Health
Sponsor: Mooney
Analyst: Bryan Yooung
Date: 03/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 495 as introduced provides that the Department of Public Health has no regulatory authority over micro markets, vending machines, or the food or beverage sold therein and that micro markets and vending machines shall be regulated by the Department of Agriculture and Industries, which would increase the obligations of the Department of Agriculture and Industries by an undetermined amount dependent upon the regulatory measures established by the Department of Agriculture and Industries.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Reynolds
Analyst: Robin Rawls
Date: 02/25/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 67 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the continuance of the State Board of Midwifery until October 1, 2025 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
